figures.label: Works coded for their modelling patterns, from excerpts
Works whose excerpts show it
One individual per kind of property, shared by all the features of interest (ex:Temperature observed on many rooms).
One individual per feature of interest: the temperature of room 1 is not that of room 2 (<office/1/temperature>).
The property is an OWL class and nothing else: a subclass of sosa:ObservableProperty, and observations point to the class.
Both: feature-specific properties linked to a generic kind of property.
Works whose excerpts show it
The work defines subclasses of sosa:ObservableProperty, sosa:ActuatableProperty or ssn:Property.
The work names its own property individuals, with no catalogue.
The properties come from an external vocabulary: QUDT quantity kinds, SWEET, ENVO, OM, I-ADOPT, SAREF, CF standard names, Wikidata…
Works whose excerpts show it
The same IRI is a class (a subclass of a SOSA/SSN class, or the object of rdf:type) and an individual (the object of observedProperty, madeBySensor…).
Classes and individuals are shown, and they are distinct.
Works whose excerpts show it
Device models or kinds are classes (subclasses of sosa:Sensor or ssn:System) and the devices are their instances, as the 2023 Edition recommends.
Each individual is one physical or software device (a serial number, :DHT22_kitchen).
An individual stands for a model or kind of device, shared by the observations of many devices (:DHT22 as the sensor of every reading).

Stratum B: cites only the earlier SSN publications (lineage seeds), published in 2018 or later
Stratum C: cites only the earlier SSN publications (lineage seeds), published before 2018
Stratum D: cites no seed: found by the SOSA/SSN names and namespaces in its full text
